title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£30,000-40,000

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.

- Coordinating pre-employment checks and recruitment documentation

About You

You will ideally have previous experience working within internal recruitment, talent acquisition or a recruitment agency, with the confidence to manage several vacancies simultaneously.

You should be able to demonstrate:
- Experience managing recruitment campaigns and vacancies
- Candidate sourcing experience across multiple recruitment channels
- Experience using LinkedIn and job boards to identify potential candidates
- Experience supporting and advising hiring managers
- Strong organisational and prioritisation skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- A proactive and practical approach to recruitment
- Confidence building relationships with candidates, hiring managers and recruitment agencies
- Strong attention to detail
- The ability to maintain accurate recruitment records and data

Previous experience within a law firm, professional services, financial services or another regulated environment would be advantageous but is not essential.

Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), recruitment technology or recruitment analytics would also be beneficial.

What's on Offer?

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established professional services organisation that places genuine emphasis on employee development and creating a positive working environment.

Benefits include:
- 25 days' annual leave plus UK Bank Holidays
- Additional day off for your birthday
- Additional annual leave over the Christmas period
- Private healthcare options
- Healthcare cashback plan for you and your family
- Enhanced pension with 5% employer-matched contribution
- Option to purchase up to three additional days' holiday each year
- Group Life Assurance at four times annual salary
- Ongoing professional and personal development opportunities

If you are an experienced Recruitment Coordinator, Talent Acquisition Coordinator, Internal Recruiter, Recruitment Consultant or Talent Acquisition professional looking to move into an in-house recruitment position within the legal/professional services sector, this could be an excellent next step.

title: Patient Services Administrator
description: Job description We are seeking a enthusiastic Patient Services Administrator to work across our two sites in The Red House Surgery & the Medical Centre based at Anglia Ruskin University. Flexibility is essential to cover shift patterns across our opening hours, which are 08:00 am to 18.30 pm Monday to Friday This position is part time, working 22 hours per week Tuesday 14:00 - 18:00 Thursday 08:00 - 18:00 Friday 08:00 - 18:00 We strive to promote a good work life balance and have a lovely working environment. We are looking for a friendly and reliable individual to join our multi-skilled administration team. To be the main point of contact for patients, both via telephone, online and face-to-face. It will be the successful candidates job to direct patients to the most appropriate care and manage patient queries in a positive and helpful way. The successful candidate will be responsible for:- Greeting Patients and visitors Answering incoming telephone calls Booking, amend and cancelling appointments Processing Patient referrals Processing repeat prescriptions Registering patients document management coding records, liaising with external services booking interpreters dealing with test results. General administration In addition, responding to tasks from clinical and non-clinical staff liaising with external community services and emergency services Reception / admin experience would be advantageous as would previous use of SystmOne although full training will be given. The ideal candidate will be flexible, friendly, with excellent customer service and IT skills and work well within a team, whilst also able to use their own initiative. Previous NHS administration experience would be advantageous but full training will be given to the right person with scope for career development. Post Titl: Patient Services Administrator Responsible to : Practice Manager Work in a team to provide a reception / administration service to the practice always ensuring a high standard of patient care. Patient Care Dealing with patients, visitors and other health professionals either in person or on the telephone To administer the appointment booking system To answer patient enquiries with the support of other practice staff as necessary Administrative To prepare repeat prescriptions in accordance with the practice policies and protocols. Scanning of referral letters, medical reports etc directly into patients electronic notes. To prepare & process referrals using the e-referral system. To undertake all tasks associated with the day-to-day running of the computer system including the links with patient services Entering new patient registrations and updating patient information onto the database. To undertake all other administrative duties necessary to support the smooth running of the surgery and as directed by the Practice Manager. Team working Develop, apply and disseminate to all reception team own areas of knowledge and expertise Continually seek ways of improving procedures and workflows to maximise effectiveness of reception team Understanding of requirement of confidentiality at all times The practice places great emphasis on team working and aims to foster good relationships throughout the team. All staff are encouraged to attend appropriate staff meetings and take part in other activities important to practice life. Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately In the performance of the duties outlined in this job description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data Health & safety: The post-holder will implement and lead on a full range of promotion and management their own and others health and safety and infection control as defined in the practice Health & Safety Policy, the practice Health & Safety Manual, and the practice Infection Control policy and published procedures. This will include (but will not be limited to): Using personal security systems within the workplace according to Practice guidelines Awareness of national standards of infection control and cleanliness and regulatory / contractual / professional requirements, and good practice guidelines Equality and diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognizes the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/Professional development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources Communication: The post-holder should recognize the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognize peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly Contribution to the implementation of services: The post-holder will: Apply practice policies, standards and guidance Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work Participate in audit where appropriate
